headline: Powering the Institutional Standard for Sustainable Bitcoin
body: SBP partners with leading miners, custodians, and energy producers to verify clean-energy hashrate at scale. Our trust layer turns renewable mining into an investable, auditable asset class — backed by transparent attestation and institutional-grade governance.
